description: Validates codeql-config.yml structure: must have 'name:' field and 'paths-ignore:' section, must NOT contain 'queries:' section (bare suite names cause 'codeql database create' to fail with 'Query pack not found').

command.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$f = '${file}'; if ($f -notmatch 'codeql-config\.yml$') { exit 0 }; $c = Get-Content $f -Raw -ErrorAction Stop; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($c)) { Write-Host '[FAIL] codeql-config.yml is empty:' $f; exit 2 }; if ($c -notmatch '(?m)^\s*name\s*:') { Write-Host '[FAIL] codeql-config.yml missing required name: field in' $f; exit 2 }; if ($c -notmatch '(?m)^\s*paths-ignore\s*:') { Write-Host '[FAIL] codeql-config.yml missing required paths-ignore: section in' $f; exit 2 }; if ($c -match '(?m)^\s*queries\s*:') { Write-Host '[FAIL] codeql-config.yml must NOT contain a queries: section (causes database create to fail with Query pack not found) in' $f; exit 2 }; exit 0"
